features.title: Register and identify local DSH runtimes
features.summary: Maintain a bounded host/runtime directory with stable runtime identity; add hosts with a searchable SSH destination picker, then edit, test, reconnect and remove them on the Hosts page.

configuration.constraints: Optional trimmed identifier of 1 to 64 characters; if supplied it must match the profile name discovered from the environment/argv.

failureModes: Profile mismatch or runtime identity change rejects registration.
Corrupt or unsupported directory data is left intact and writes are refused.

verification.testName: corrupt directory stays untouched and rejects writes instead of replacing user data

features.title: Manage hosts on a dedicated page
features.summary: A Hosts page lists every registered host in the destination picker's order: hide a host without deleting it, drag rows or use the arrows to reorder, and reconnect, edit or remove from the same row.
failureModes: A partial or duplicate order is refused and the stored order stays.
Hiding a host keeps its runtimes, threads and remote data; it only leaves the destination picker.

verification.testName: moves one id to the drop index and keeps the rest in order
hides a host without touching its runtimes, and a later edit keeps it hidden

verification.reason: The Hosts page needs registered hosts, which the loopback SSH journey does not seed. The catalog reach drives the real page with the multi-host-hosts scratch seed (dshx dev open multi-host/host-management), and the store/order unit tests prove hide, reorder and order persistence.

features.title: Connect to an SSH-managed runtime
features.summary: Discover a remote DSH through its launch file over SSH, verify pinned identity/capabilities, keep one pooled tunnel per runtime, and never accept unknown host keys or forward the agent.
failureModes: Host-key or identity mismatch rejects attachment.
A missing or stale launch file reports runtime-not-running instead of connecting.

externalDependencies.boundary: System OpenSSH client and the remote runtime's plugins/multi-host/launch.json.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: tests/ssh.integration.test.ts runs the real ssh binary; the live suite needs MULTI_HOST_SSH_TARGET and MULTI_HOST_SSH_HOME.

telemetry.testName: records an ssh command span that fails on a refused target before ssh starts

features.title: Use the native composer for remote threads
features.summary: Open a native thread composer on a selected remote host, then keep its model catalog and reasoning-effort picker, file attachments, and @ file references bound to that Session's owning runtime; follow and reply in the same native chat.
failureModes: A capability or version mismatch disables incompatible actions.
A file-reference request for an unowned Session or wrong runtime is refused before the remote filesystem is queried.
An unknown mutation result after a lost reply is inspected and never automatically replayed.

externalDependencies.boundary: Token-authenticated HTTP/WebSocket RPC to a selected DSH runtime.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Use an injected in-memory gateway transport with synthetic token and runtime identities; no real DSH profile credentials.

verification.testName: reports an admitted create as unknown after its reply is lost and reconciles without replay

telemetry.testName: records one <namespace>/<method> gateway span with the outcome code, never the arguments

features.title: Open the host's own DSH UI
features.summary: Lease the pooled tunnel for a stable loopback origin and open the remote runtime's UI in a new tab.
failureModes: A dropped tunnel retires the lease; the next open reconnects.
Lease release never mutates the remote runtime.

verification.reason: The current scratch E2E proves an SSH connection to a second DSH and native session APIs, but does not open the remote DSH UI or verify tunnel-lease release/drop recovery. Keep the browser view lifecycle unverified until a dedicated remote-view journey covers it.

verification.testName: creates one child folder and refuses nested or empty names
lists folders and folder symlinks, hidden ones last, with crumbs; files are left out

features.title: Every thread on every host
features.summary: The remote threads panel merges threads started from this DSH with the sessions each host reports, grouped by host: threads started on the host itself carry a muted badge, an offline host shows one unavailable line, and status is polled only while the list is open.
failureModes: A failed status keeps that host's started-here rows instead of dropping them.
A blank host session (never received a message) stays out of the list.
reach: click button "All remote threads, including ones started on a host"

verification.testName: a thread in both sources appears once with its stored title and started-here flag

features.title: A remote turn waiting on the host
features.summary: When a remote turn stops on ask_user_question or holds a tool call open, the open-thread view says what it waits on above the composer and points at the host's DSH; a generic tool call is only called out after a minute because the log cannot tell a slow command from a pending approval.
failureModes: A missing waiting field is read as not waiting, so an older Host still renders.
A tool result or a turn end clears the wait.
reach: click button "All remote threads, including ones started on a host"
fill textbox "Reply on Remote loopback" "Here is my answer: name it sample."
expect text "Here is my answer: name it sample.*"

verification.testName: an open ask_user_question call while the turn runs is a question, including an MCP-prefixed name
a turn end clears the wait

verification.reason: No provider credential is available to the headless E2E scratch runtime, so it cannot run a remote agent turn that calls ask_user_question. The banner is driven in the scratch UI with `dshx dev open multi-host/waiting-on-host` against a free-model remote runtime instead.

ioDelegation.reason: Raw TCP forward and port probe for the SSH tunnel; every request through it is a gateway <namespace>/<method> span and the tunnel itself an ssh tunnel open span.
